inputs.REQUESTED_DOMAIN: Terraform Plugin Framework provider for Ansible-backed local Linux managed resources

CANDIDATES.OBJECTIVE: Complete the ten-resource ansibleops provider as one coherent Terraform lifecycle/reconciliation system.
CANDIDATES.PERSONA: Platform engineer maintaining an internal Terraform provider for local Linux configuration through Ansible.
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: large_system_strict: ten differentiated resources share lifecycle, state, observation, runner, ownership and normalization subsystems while exposing broad failure/reconciliation surfaces.

outputs.WHY_THIS_ONE: The inherited task naturally spans provider runtime, stable external identity, Terraform state transactionality, Ansible process execution, native Linux drift observation, scoped deletion, account/cron semantics and normalization. The shared invariants create connected production defects rather than ten isolated toy fixes.
